title: Cosmos-Drive-Dreams: Scalable Synthetic Driving Data Generation with World Foundation Models

output_modality.value: Multi-view driving video (single-view video expanded to several views); a separate model generates LiDAR points.

control_signal.value: HDMap and 3D cuboid condition videos, text prompts (weather, time of day), optional LiDAR depth; ego trajectory customised via a GUI that interpolates camera poses and re-renders the HDMap video.

control_mechanism.value: ControlNet branches on a frozen Cosmos DiT base take HDMap/LiDAR condition tokens; text enters by per-view cross-attention; multi-view expansion concatenates clean input-view tokens with noisy tokens plus view indicators.

base_model.value: Cosmos-1 world foundation model, a 7B DiT text-to-video diffusion model, post-trained for driving (Sample-AV variants, Transfer1, Single2Multiview).

datasets.value: 2,000 hours of internal driving footage, RDS-HQ (including human-labelled subset RDS-HQ-HL), Waymo Open Dataset.

metrics.value: Downstream only in the packet: LET-AP/APH/APL (BEVFormer 3D detection), LATR 3D lane detection, mAP (LiDAR detection), minADE with 5s horizon (policy). No FID or FVD seen.

controllability_evidence.value: Indirect, via downstream gains: lane-detection gain of +6.0% at 2k real clips, up to +9.4% in fog; adding SDG to 1K real clips gives +55.0% relative LET-AP, comparable to 9.3x more real data.

closed_loop.value: No. Offline synthetic data generation (121-frame chunks); policy evaluated open-loop with minADE.

stated_limitations.value: Reliance on computationally heavy diffusion models makes large-scale generation time- and resource-intensive; left to future optimization.

notes: Packet has no direct condition-following or fidelity metric. Control family could also be read as trajectory plus text; HDMap-based layout control is the core.
